scientific_choices.choice: Inspected local3.4/3.5/Figure4/Algorithm2: BLIP2 scene context and whole-image DeepSolo fallback. Residual-text VQA is a new external hypothesis, not specified by the paper.

Reuse qualified original425 images,640 YOLO/PARSeq boxes/words, image-only BLIP2 captions, frozen consistency controls and complete DeepSolo branches; pinned same BLIP2-FLAN-T5-XL checkpoint/revision and hashes as captions.

Mask union of all original predicted exclusive boxes with gray128 and separately global Gaussian blur radius .05*min(image dimensions), applied only within the union. Preserve all pixels outside boxes. Overlap order-independent. A box may also hide missed words; explicit limitation. Save array hashes and masked fraction; no label/ignore map in features.

Frozen BLIP2 Yes/No with EOS normalized teacher-forced probability on original, hard residual, blur residual, and gray blank control. Plain/context questions held fixed. The largest residual probability across mask types is conservative risk. Visual drop is original probability minus maximum residual; context_specific is context drop minus plain drop. Blank-image caption bias is diagnostic. Original word outputs unchanged.

Staged vision/QFormer/projection reused across questions; verify logits against native transformers forward on first real image, max tolerance2e-4. No AMP, offload, quantization, truncation or model substitution. Local pinned checkpoint only; failures/OOM propagate and retain receipt.

Label-free CDF onlyTRAIN80, fixed sqrt(baseline*CDF), family choice onlyTRAIN80, cuts onlyTRAIN45, freeze before newTEST VQA. Report all12 families and fixed-primary, historically explored TEST. No optimizer, gradients, fitted mixture weights or new network training.

RTX3090 qualified at execution; single GPU sequential FP32 BLIP2 needs more memory than historical8GB machine. Record allocated/reserved peaks, original/processed shapes, batches, state hashes before/after, all failures. This is approximate, not8GB qualified or strict paper reproduction.

BLIP2 image224 may miss small text, hallucinate residual text from scene priors, or react to mask edges. Masking may hide unrecognized words inside a known box. No generalization guarantee from45 calibration images. Missing-region existence alone cannot prove exact spelling or F1>=.8.
